page.overview:
Who is Cast Iron?

Milos Stojakovic (better known as Cast Iron) is a minor character in Invincible, debuting in Season 3. He is a superhero with the ability of transform his body into steel.

In his transformed form, he has grayish skin. He wears a predominantly red and beige outfit, his chest is covered in beige armor or uniform, while the arms and legs are red. It has a symbol of two crossed hammers on the belt, reminiscent of a working-class or industrial look.

Nothing much known about Cast Iron's backstory. Save for the fact, he became a superhero and works for the G.D.A.

Cast Iron can be seen at Day I, preparing to fight against Prisonincible when he invaded Russia.
